summary_paragraph: The patient was readmitted three days after discharge due to persistent nausea, vomiting, and non-bloody diarrhea that never resolved at home. She had been previously diagnosed with norovirus gastroenteritis and was treated supportively with IV fluids, anti-nausea medications, and gradual advancement of diet from clear liquids to regular meals. Her symptoms improved over four days, and she tolerated oral intake without recurrence of nausea or vomiting. Tube feeds were held during admission to avoid exacerbating diarrhea. She was discharged home in stable condition with instructions to follow up with her primary care provider and bariatric surgeon regarding G-tube removal.
problems: Acute gastroenteropathy due to Norwalk agent
